Real businesses here are invented examples, none of them the 10 eval fixtures. Cases with ids starting 'holdout-' were added 2026-10-18 after the classifier prompt's isBusiness line was written, as a holdout (not used to tune it). `pnpm eval:junk` classifies them and reports whether the classifier's isBusiness sorts them and the confidence that would (tiers.junk.minClassifierConfidence).
